data.source_text: bhīruko bhīruka-jano lubdho lubdha-janas tathā

data.text: Hungry for meat, he took his bow and went into the forest.

translations.text: सः मांसे लुब्धः धनुः आदाय वनं गतः।

data.source_text: sa caikadā māṃsa-lubdho dhanur ādāya mṛgam anviṣyan vindhyāṭavī-madhyaṃ gataḥ

data.text: A king favours whoever happens to be close to him.

data.text: A breach of duty is close at hand.
